Mixed purées

Cornmeal and fruit cup

Gyümölcsös kukoricakása

8 months+ Adjusted 20 min 4 portions

A side from eight months, next to meat, lentils, or egg, not the meal by itself.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 50 g fine cornmeal (not whole corn kernels, and not wheat semolina)
  • 300 ml water
  • 100 g cooked apple (peeled, cored, and cooked, with no sugar)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel, core, and cook the apple until soft, then mash it.
  2. Whisk the cornmeal into the water.
  3. Cook, stirring, until it is soft and spoonable, about 10 minutes.
  4. Stir in the apple and cool until warm.
  5. Do not add sugar, and do not use whole kernels.
  6. Serve it beside an iron food, not as the only dish.

Adjusted

Cornmeal porridge is low in iron, so it cannot be the whole meal. Whole corn kernels are the wrong texture, and sugar is sometimes added.

Cook fine cornmeal into a soft porridge with cooked apple, and do not use whole kernels or sugar. Serve it as a side from 8 months, when a thicker texture is reasonable.
